reason: The return plant needs stable ground, so I’ll prepare the site with the excavator first.
expectation: I expect it to clear or level the ground for the plant.

alternatives.reason: The spare modules will likely supply power, but the site seems worth preparing first.

effect: The excavator graded the site, so I can now prepare its surface.
reaction: The result was straightforward but gave no detail about the grading.
reason: Ceramic blocks on the graded site seem like a sensible next step toward a stable industrial base.
expectation: I expect the blocks to form a level, durable plant foundation, though their precise role is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: The solar modules will likely be needed for power, but I want to finish preparing the site first.

effect: The blocks spread equipment loads on the cleared footing, completing the site; power is now the priority.
reaction: The explanation made the foundation's purpose clear.
reason: The spare solar modules need support to provide power for the plant.
expectation: I expect the steel to form a support for the solar modules, though a cable may still be needed.

effect: The modules are now on an extended rack, so connecting power is the next step.
reaction: The result matched my expectation, though it gave no further detail.
reason: The cable should connect the solar rack to the plant's power system.
expectation: I expect a usable solar power supply for the return plant, though further connections may be needed.

effect: The rack is connected through its own controller, completing the industrial power goal while preserving the growing room's allocation.
reaction: The explanation of shared power and slow fuel production made the connection more meaningful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the solar rack was most worthwhile: it tied the return plan to the station's existing power needs and clarified the tradeoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the solar rack was a predictable intermediate step with little detail in its result.

surprise.text: The industrial supply uses spare capacity while the growing room keeps its allocation, and making fuel will be much slower.

arbitrary.text: Nothing I chose felt arbitrary; the footing and power connections had clear purposes.

continue.text: Yes. The discovery and return plan make me curious how the fuel production and sample recovery will unfold, though this chapter's construction was fairly straightforward.
